note: Story 23.12's ten live-evaluation questions. {failingTask} is the task the seed found failed and suspended: the install's demo task, or EVAL2312's own when the demo task is absent. Each question runs in a new conversation with no screen context.

questions.question: Which tasks are suspended?
questions.rightWhen: It names every task the schedule shows Suspended (the demo task and the three EVAL2312 suspended tasks), and no other.

questions.question: Which task runs failed in the last 24 hours?
questions.rightWhen: It names every task whose run failed in the history read (the demo task at least), not "none".

questions.question: Which databases are dismounted?
questions.rightWhen: It names EVAL2312DISM and every other database the read shows Dismounted.

questions.question: Which databases are remote, and which server holds each?
An error about the EVAL2312 journal disk check was reported in the last hour. Which log holds it, and what does it say?
questions.rightWhen: It names messages.log and quotes the seeded text.

questions.question: What application error was raised in the USER namespace in the last hour?
questions.rightWhen: It reports the seeded <DIVIDE> in USER, not "none" and not messages.log.

questions.question: Are any background jobs, such as a database compact, running or failed?
questions.rightWhen: It gives the rows the read shows ("none" when empty) and names Background tasks among the lists checked.

questions.question: When does the task EVAL2312 weekly report run next?
Did {failingTask} succeed the last time it ran, and what did it report?
questions.rightWhen: It failed, with its Result error text.

questions.question: Is auditing on for this instance, and is the LoginFailure event enabled?
questions.rightWhen: Both values as those reads show them.
